Expensive is not meant in a monetary way. I mean it in developer time, both in time to implement a feature and to maintain it from then on.

The more ways to sort and the longer the project moves on, the more. It's not simply changes which need to be applied to every filter, it's also handling bugs which might only occur with some filters. It multiplies the testing by the amount of sorting settings.
